name: jsonschema-e2e-lang-support
displayName: JSON Schema Preview — E2E language support (test only)
description: Contribution-only fixture extension loaded via extensionDevelopmentPath during the S08 integration suite. Registers the `toml` language id and the `yaml.schemas` configuration key, which no bundled VS Code extension provides — they are normally contributed by third-party marketplace extensions (tamasfe.even-better-toml, redhat.vscode-yaml). Loading these declaratively keeps the run deterministic and offline instead of installing marketplace extensions in CI.

yaml.schemas.description: Test-only registration of yaml.schemas so the S08 suite can write folder/workspace/user-scoped YAML bindings without the redhat.vscode-yaml extension.
